title: The model predicts material-free normalized outputs; units appear only at display
context: train_synth.py extract_outputs() divides stiffness by E_solid, pore size by cell size and conductivity by k_solid per sweep. 30-material.js multiplies back using the material card shared with Vault through localStorage (f13ld.vault.globalInputs.v1).

options.name: Normalized targets, scale at display (current)
options.summary: Geometry-only model; physical GPa, µm, W/mK computed from the material card.
pros: Changing material never invalidates the model
Pools sweeps run on different materials
cons: Assumes linear scaling with solid properties
Rows missing a reference value lose that metric (e.g. 414 rows with no k_solid)

options.name: Material as an input feature
options.summary: Feed E_solid, k_solid etc. into the model and predict physical values.
cons: Needs far more data per material
Model changes with every new material

recommendation: README "Material card" says the trainer always works in normalized space and resolution happens at display only; train_synth.py extract_outputs() and 30-material.js implement it.
